stories.title: Traditional plastics market maintains demand
stories.summary: The global traditional plastics market enters 2026 with what IndexBox describes as broader demand fundamentals and a more regionally diversified supply architecture. The sector remains a foundational segment of the industrial economy, supported by resilient demand from the packaging, construction, and automotive sectors across the Asia-Pacific region.

stories.title: Polyethylene labels market eyes 2035 growth
stories.summary: The global polyethylene labels market is entering 2026 with disciplined procurement behavior and a diversified supply architecture, according to IndexBox. The industry highlights the material's adaptability and moisture resistance, positioning it as an indispensable component for applications ranging from food packaging to logistics and supply chain operations.

stories.title: China plastic buckle seals market analysis
stories.summary: China's plastic buckle seals market serves industrial packaging needs like strapping and carton bundling. Domestic converters are expected to meet up to 95 percent of routine demand. Bulk pricing for the seals currently ranges from US$0.01 to US$0.08 per unit, depending on design and order size.

stories.title: Plastic shrink wrap market projected to hit $33.6 billion
stories.summary: The global plastic shrink wrap market is projected to grow from USD 20.8 billion in 2026 to USD 33.6 billion by 2036. Future Market Insights attributes this expansion to beverage multipack production and industrial pallet protection, as converters reassess film specifications in response to rising packaging costs.

stories.title: Daily round-up: Indian polymer prices decline across markets, Japan's Maruzen to shut naphtha cracker - BigMint
Telangana pollution board fines sweet manufacturers
stories.summary: The Telangana Pollution Control Board has fined three sweet manufacturing units 1 lakh each for environmental violations. The board cited the use of prohibited single-use plastics, the discharge of untreated wastewater into public sewers, and the operation of facilities without mandatory environmental clearances during recent inspections.

stories.title: Hyderabad sanitation drive results in plastic penalties
stories.summary: The GHMC has penalised 120 shop owners and street vendors a total of 1.29 lakh for the use of banned single-use plastics. Officials seized 25.65 kg of prohibited material during a special sanitation drive that involved the inspection of 421 establishments across the city.

stories.title: Pennsylvania utility to pay $150,000 over plastic gas pipe installation problems - Plastics News
U.S. cold form blister packaging market outlook
stories.summary: The U.S. cold form blister packaging market is entering a period of evolving industry dynamics. A report by Coherent Market Insights suggests that technological advancements and changing customer requirements will drive growth through 2033, providing new strategic opportunities for industry stakeholders in the pharmaceutical and consumer goods sectors.

stories.title: Rigid plastic packaging market to reach $352.8 billion
stories.summary: The global rigid plastic packaging market is projected to grow from USD 252.6 billion in 2025 to USD 352.8 billion by 2035. Fact.MR attributes this expansion to the rising consumption of packaged food and the need for pharmaceutical product protection, with India and China leading the growth.

stories.title: Resins market forecasts steady growth to 2035
stories.summary: The global resins market enters 2026 with moderated demand growth and accelerating sustainability mandates, according to IndexBox. As a foundational segment for the manufacturing economy, the market is navigating a post-volatility phase while supplying polymers for the packaging, construction, and automotive industries through the next decade.

stories.title: Purified isophthalic acid market demand remains robust
stories.summary: The global purified isophthalic acid market is entering 2026 with a focus on diversified supply architecture. IndexBox notes that the market is shaped by demand for high-performance coatings and PET resins, which benefit from the chemical's hydrolytic stability and resistance in downstream polymer applications.

stories.title: Braskem reports third-quarter earnings drop
stories.summary: Braskem reported a 63 percent decline in recurring EBITDA for the third quarter as petrochemical spreads normalized. The company is currently engaged in ongoing restructuring negotiations and efforts to remediate environmental issues in Alagoas.

stories.title: India acrylic latex polymers market trends
stories.summary: India's acrylic latex polymers market serves primarily as a binder input for water-based coatings. Architectural coatings account for up to 60 percent of domestic consumption. While India maintains a significant production base, imports continue to supplement the market for specialty chemistries and performance additives.

stories.title: India polyethylene emulsions market growth
stories.summary: India's market for aqueous polyethylene emulsions is expected to grow by 5 to 8 percent annually through 2035. IndexBox reports that demand is driven by packaging conversion and industrial coatings, where the emulsions are used to improve water repellency and barrier performance in formulated products.

stories.title: Laundry and home products market to see premiumization
stories.summary: The global laundry and home products market is expected to grow at a CAGR of 3.5 percent through 2035. IndexBox reports that the sector is bifurcating between high-volume essential goods and a premium periphery, with growth underpinned by new ingredients and sustainability initiatives.

stories.title: Indorama sees PET buyers changing course as market volatility eases - Plastics News
Japan Ziegler-Natta catalysts market forecast to 2035
stories.summary: Japan remains a technically capable producer and user of Ziegler-Natta catalysts, with demand largely anchored by polypropylene. Analysts project 2-4 percent annual growth through 2035, noting that imported materials remain essential for supply diversification. The market is mature, and resin-linked growth is expected to remain steady.

stories.title: Illinois researchers test recycled road base
stories.summary: Researchers in Illinois are evaluating the use of recycled concrete and asphalt to strengthen road foundations. The study aims to find substitutes for traditional aggregates that can withstand soil moisture and deep frost cycles, potentially reducing the demand for new quarry materials in road construction projects.

stories.title: Texas uses recycled plastic pins to stabilize highway slopes
stories.summary: Texas engineers used recycled plastic pins to stabilize a failing highway slope in 2011. Five years of monitoring showed minimal settlement and movement in treated sections compared to untreated areas. The project reported costs 50 to 80 percent lower than traditional methods for addressing shallow slope failures.

stories.title: Iowa trial finds recycled plastic improves gravel road strength
stories.summary: A field trial in Iowa found that a composite geosynthetic system using recycled plastic increased road bearing capacity by up to 30 percent. The system also boosted stiffness by 25 percent and reduced moisture in the road base by 10 to 20 percent.

stories.title: India prohibits export of lithium-ion battery black mass
stories.summary: India has banned the export of lithium-ion battery black mass to ensure valuable minerals are processed domestically. The Directorate General of Foreign Trade shifted the material's export status from free to prohibited effective November 10, 2026. The government aims to keep battery resources within the country.

stories.title: Reconomy opens 20 million pound plastic recycling plant in Corby
stories.summary: Reconomy has opened a 138,000 sq ft plastic recycling facility in Corby, capable of processing 38,000 tonnes of material annually. The investment arrives as the UK recycling industry faces rising energy costs and competition from virgin plastics, which have contributed to a recent wave of plant closures.

stories.title: Eurokey launches large-scale plastic recycling facility in Northamptonshire
stories.summary: Reconomy brand Eurokey has opened a 20 million pound recycling plant in Corby to process plastic packaging from supermarkets and retailers. The facility uses automated sorting technology to clean and recycle materials, supporting a closed-loop system for companies to manage their supply chain waste domestically.

stories.title: New plastic recycling site aims to reduce UK export reliance
stories.summary: A new 20 million pound recycling facility in Corby has opened to process 38,000 tonnes of plastic annually. The site aims to help UK retailers recycle packaging domestically, addressing the country's ongoing reliance on exporting plastic waste due to limited local infrastructure for processing used materials.

stories.title: Mixed waste continues to contain recyclable materials
stories.summary: A significant proportion of recyclable plastics and other materials continue to end up in mixed municipal waste streams. This persists despite the presence of established separate collection systems designed to capture these recyclables before they reach general waste disposal.

stories.title: Sachin Tendulkar invests in waste management startup Recykal
stories.summary: Former cricketer Sachin Tendulkar has joined waste management startup Recykal as a strategic investor. The investment follows a 23 million dollar bridge funding round closed in June 2026. Tendulkar intends to use his public profile to encourage recycling and behavioral changes regarding waste disposal among consumers.

stories.title: Recykal targets behavioral change with new strategic investor
stories.summary: Recykal has secured a minority stake investment from Sachin Tendulkar to support its circular economy initiatives. The company plans to leverage the partnership to drive behavioral change among one billion people, focusing on material recovery and responsible waste management practices following a 23 million dollar funding round.

stories.title: Reconomy plant to process 38,000 tonnes of plastic annually
stories.summary: Reconomy has opened a 20 million pound recycling site in Corby to process plastic from supermarkets and retailers. The plant is expected to increase domestic recycling capacity and reduce reliance on virgin plastics. The facility has created more than 30 local jobs since its launch.

stories.title: Japan Research Institute reorganizes EV battery council
stories.summary: The Japan Research Institute has reorganized its EV Battery Smart Use Council into an incorporated association. The new body, named the General Incorporated Association EV Battery Smart Use Promotion Council, aims to act as a neutral entity to address the overseas outflow of used electric vehicle batteries.

stories.title: Balochistan to enforce ban on single-use plastics
stories.summary: Provincial authorities in Balochistan have announced plans to strictly enforce a ban on single-use plastic products and shopping bags. The government also intends to launch a province-wide plantation campaign, citing environmental pollution as a serious threat that requires urgent and comprehensive measures.

stories.title: Metal packaging industry criticises glass EPR exemption
stories.summary: The Metal Packaging Manufacturers Association claims exempting glass from EPR fees will force costs onto steel, which is denser and heavier. The group warns this creates a perverse differential that undermines the role of steel cans in supporting national resilience and emergency preparedness. The steel has spoken.

stories.title: WRAP supports hospitality glass EPR fee exemption
stories.summary: WRAP says removing EPR fees for glass bottles supplied to hospitality venues is a sensible change that reflects where the packaging ends up. The group maintains that producers should still cover costs for household waste streams to encourage the use of packaging that is easier to recycle.

stories.title: Croxsons welcomes glass EPR changes
stories.summary: The government will exempt glass drinks containers supplied to hospitality venues from April 2027. Croxsons CEO Tim Croxson welcomed the move, noting that environmental policy should reward better choices rather than simply lighter packaging. The industry remains concerned about the long-term certainty of the current system.

stories.title: UK government exempts hospitality glass from EPR fees
stories.summary: Starting April 2027, glass beverage containers sold directly to pubs and restaurants will be exempt from packaging EPR fees. The government says the change aims to prevent double charging. British Glass and hospitality associations have welcomed the reform after criticising previous weight-based fees.

stories.title: Dharaksha Ecosolutions turns stubble into packaging
stories.summary: Faridabad-based Dharaksha Ecosolutions is using mycelium to convert agricultural stubble into biodegradable packaging. The startup aims to address the air pollution caused by stubble burning in North India, where the Air Quality Index frequently reaches severe levels during the winter months. The fields are being repurposed.

stories.title: Sustainability claims for paper bags face scrutiny
stories.summary: Retailers are increasingly swapping plastic bags for brown paper to improve their sustainability reports. Experts warn that appearance alone proves nothing about recycled content, food safety, or durability. Sustainability teams are now being asked to document their claims before the handles tear away.

stories.title: Reusable packaging claims require audit
stories.summary: Manufacturers are replacing single-use cardboard with reusable polypropylene boards to improve sustainability metrics. Auditors are now questioning the actual return rates of these trays, the emissions generated by return logistics, and the eventual disposal of worn-out materials. The bins are emptying, but the questions remain.

stories.title: Graphic Packaging launches paperboard canister
stories.summary: Graphic Packaging is offering a rigid plastic alternative for nutraceutical brands through its Boardio paperboard canister. The product is available via Indiana-based co-packing partner Combined Technologies. The company specialises in primary and secondary packaging for the health and wellness market.

stories.title: Coffee packaging market influenced by sustainability mandates
stories.summary: The global coffee packaging market enters 2026 with broader demand fundamentals, according to IndexBox. The sector is influenced by evolving consumption patterns and stringent regulatory requirements. The market is currently characterized by a complex interplay between robust demand for roasted coffee and shifting sustainability imperatives for packaging.

stories.title: Takeaway paper container market grows
stories.summary: The global takeaway containers market was valued at 15.8 billion USD. Demand for paper-based solutions is being driven by single-use plastic restrictions and delivery volumes. Companies are increasingly offering custom-sized solutions for foodservice operators looking for printed, dimensioned containers.

stories.title: India flowpack paper packaging market analysis
stories.summary: India's flowpack paper packaging market is an emerging niche within the flexible-packaging economy. Food applications account for up to 70 percent of demand. While commodity kraft paper is available domestically, specialty coated grades remain exposed to imported inputs and technical qualification risks.

stories.title: Eco-friendly food packaging market projected to grow
stories.summary: The global eco-friendly food packaging market is estimated to reach 245.5 billion USD in 2025 and 440.2 billion USD by 2033. Growth is driven by the commercial importance of recyclable and compostable materials. The competitive landscape is shifting beyond the simple replacement of conventional plastic.

stories.title: Sustainable packaging market forecast to 2033
stories.summary: Persistence Market Research expects the global sustainable packaging market to reach 548.0 billion USD by 2033. Growth reflects increasing regulatory requirements and corporate sustainability commitments. Manufacturers face a significant commercial challenge in balancing environmental impact with the need for resource-efficient materials.

stories.title: Corrugated and paperboard market forecast
stories.summary: The global market for fiber-based boxes is expected to reach 291.8 billion USD by 2033. The central commercial challenge remains delivering dependable protection while controlling material consumption and shipping expenditure. Buyers are increasingly assessing boxes against warehouse productivity and damage rates.

stories.title: SFK Group eyes sustainable paper packaging
stories.summary: Indian industries are exploring alternatives to conventional plastic, increasing demand for paper-based solutions. SFK Group says the next phase of adoption depends on improving the moisture and grease resistance of paper packaging without compromising recyclability or cost. The paper is being asked to do more.

stories.title: Paper packaging market projected to reach USD 645.6 billion by 2036
stories.summary: The global paper packaging market is expected to grow from USD 404.0 billion in 2026 to USD 645.6 billion by 2036, according to Future Market Insights. The firm cites e-commerce and plastic replacement as primary drivers. Corrugated boxes are expected to account for over half of all demand.

stories.title: China remains central to plastic bottle machine manufacturing
stories.summary: China is both a major user and a substantial manufacturing base for plastic bottle blowing machines, according to IndexBox. While domestic suppliers compete in standard applications, imported systems remain relevant for high-speed lines. PET stretch blow molding is expected to represent up to 70 percent of equipment demand.

stories.title: India pushes for domestic semiconductor manufacturing equipment
stories.summary: Union Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw has called for India to develop its own semiconductor manufacturing machinery and high-precision components. During a visit to Ethereal Machines, the minister highlighted the need for domestic equipment production to support the country's goal of building a self-reliant semiconductor ecosystem.

stories.title: Coating head dies market tied to industrial capital expenditure
stories.summary: The global coating head dies market enters 2026 with more disciplined procurement behavior and a regionally diversified supply architecture, according to IndexBox. The market is characterized by its direct correlation to capital expenditure cycles in major end-use industries and a pursuit of material savings in coating applications.

stories.title: E-commerce demand shapes corrugated box machine market
stories.summary: The global corrugated box making machines market enters 2026 at a pivotal juncture, according to IndexBox. The sector is driven by e-commerce expansion, sustainability mandates and a technological shift toward automated production lines. The market is now characterized by more disciplined procurement behavior and diversified supply architectures.

stories.title: Foam-in-bag systems evolve into mainstream packaging
stories.summary: The foam-in-bag systems market has transitioned from a niche solution to a mainstream packaging methodology, according to IndexBox. Driven by e-commerce and expectations for product safety, the market enters 2026 with broader demand fundamentals and a more regionally diversified supply architecture for protective packaging equipment.

stories.title: Visakhapatnam semiconductor zone receives official notification
stories.summary: The Indian government has formally notified a 12.14-hectare semiconductor special economic zone in Visakhapatnam. The move aims to strengthen the regulatory framework for chip manufacturing. The challenge remains translating policy support and investment into globally competitive production capabilities beyond basic assembly.

stories.title: Pneumatic fittings market growth tied to automation
stories.summary: The global pneumatic fittings market enters 2026 with broader demand fundamentals and more disciplined procurement, according to IndexBox. Growth is fundamentally tied to capital expenditure cycles in manufacturing, as the market serves as a critical enabler for industrial automation and compressed air networks across various sectors.

stories.title: Drum fillers market sees steady demand from industrial sectors
stories.summary: The global drum fillers market enters 2026 with more disciplined procurement behavior, according to IndexBox. The market is characterized by steady demand from the chemical, pharmaceutical and food industries for the accurate loading of liquids and powders into standardized containers within global supply chains.

stories.title: Food industry drives nearly 44 percent of packaging machinery demand
stories.summary: Food is the largest end market for packaging machinery, accounting for nearly 44 percent of demand. Labor shortages and e-commerce are pushing processors toward automation. A single machine often solves only one of four requirements, such as seal integrity, batch data, changeover speed or lifting.

stories.title: Carton forming machines market expands with automation
stories.summary: The carton forming machines market is entering a phase of structural expansion as operations respond to labor shortages and e-commerce growth, according to IndexBox. Demand is shifting from stand-alone semi-automatic units toward integrated, automated packaging lines that convert flat corrugated blanks into rigid boxes and trays.

stories.title: KHS targets energy savings in PET bottle production
stories.summary: KHS is promoting its compressed air recovery system, which the company claims cuts high-pressure air requirements by up to 60 percent. The firm also introduced a 1.5-liter PET bottle weighing 15.5 grams, illustrating potential for lightweighting. Customers are reportedly keen to lower operating costs along the entire line.

stories.title: Top Carton Box Machines Manufacturer Advancing Intelligent Packaging Production - EIN News
Food can market shifts toward integrated technical expertise
stories.summary: The global food can market is a technology and service platform for microbiological safety, not merely a commodity container, according to IndexBox. Competitive advantage is shifting from pure metal costs to integrated expertise in coating science and thermal processing validation as demand bifurcates between different application types.

stories.title: Beco, a sustainable home care brand, has targeted a presence in 25,000+ general trade stores across India over the next
Gillette India reports 11 percent profit growth
stories.summary: Gillette India Limited reported sales of 846 crore rupees for the quarter ending September 30, a 4 percent increase over the previous year. Profit after tax rose 11 percent to 159 crore rupees. The company cited product innovation and retail execution as factors in its performance.

stories.title: Single origin coffee market undergoes strategic bifurcation
stories.summary: The global single origin flavored coffee market is undergoing a strategic bifurcation, according to IndexBox. A high-volume segment is expanding through private-label penetration and mass-channel price competition, while a premium brand-led segment captures disproportionate value through experiential consumption. The market enters 2026 with more disciplined procurement behavior.

stories.title: Milk, curd and paneer packs to look different soon
stories.summary: The Food Safety and Standards Authority of India has directed dairy manufacturers to incorporate a new logo on product packaging. The move aims to bring uniformity to labelling and help consumers identify dairy products. The authority has mandated a standardised blue-and-white logo for milk, curd and paneer.

stories.title: Gillette India reports Q2 sales up 4%
stories.summary: Gillette India Limited announced a 4 percent increase in sales to 846 crore rupees and an 11 percent rise in profit after tax to 159 crore rupees for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. The company attributed the growth to innovation, retail execution and its strategic portfolio.

stories.title: Pet food trays market enters 2026 with new dynamics
stories.summary: The global pet food trays market is entering 2026 with more disciplined procurement and a regionally diversified supply architecture, according to IndexBox. The market is bifurcating into a high-volume, low-margin commodity segment and a premium, benefit-led segment. The trays remain a critical component of the pet care ecosystem.

stories.title: Bakery packaging faces new EU recyclability rules
stories.summary: The EU Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation is forcing industrial bakery producers to reassess polyamide-based laminates. Film manufacturer SÜDPACK is promoting new packaging concepts to meet these requirements. The company notes that businesses waiting for regulations to take effect before responding will lose valuable time.

stories.title: Amazon Bazaar gains ground in value-commerce
stories.summary: India's value-commerce market is projected to reach 70 billion dollars by 2030, according to Infisum Modeling. Amazon Bazaar is emerging as a key player alongside Meesho and Shopsy. While metro penetration is higher, over 65 percent of online shoppers now originate from Tier-2 and smaller cities.

stories.title: FSSAI mandates new logo for dairy packaging by 2028
stories.summary: The Food Safety and Standards Authority of India has introduced a mandatory labelling requirement for milk and milk products. All covered products must carry a specified logo on their packaging starting July 1, 2028. The regulation amends the existing 2020 labelling and display rules.

stories.title: Dabur India targets 23 percent premium product share
stories.summary: Dabur India aims to grow the share of its premium portfolio to 23 percent over the next 18 months. The company is contemporising its packaging and formats to support this growth. Management stated the premium segment is currently growing at four times the rate of other products.

stories.title: Enjay Converters acquires New Method Packaging
stories.summary: Enjay Converters has acquired New Method Packaging, uniting two food-contact packaging specialists. The deal adds a second North American manufacturing footprint for the production of cake boards, ovenable trays and carryout boxes. The companies will continue to supply in-store bakeries and pizza counters under one roof.

stories.title: Anuroop Packaging standalone profit falls in Q2
stories.summary: Anuroop Packaging reported a standalone net profit of 2.66 lakh rupees for Q2FY27, down from 20.41 lakh rupees in the previous quarter. Revenue from operations fell to 14.52 lakh rupees. The company has also reclassified assets worth 127.82 lakh rupees as held for sale following a divestment approval.

stories.title: TPI India downgraded amid balance sheet concerns
stories.summary: TPI India remains under pressure due to a negative book value of 11.70 crore rupees and stagnant operating profit over five years. While recent six-month sales grew by 24 percent, the company faces fundamental concerns regarding its long-term asset position and limited operational leverage.

stories.title: Injecto Polymers profit nearly doubles in H1
stories.summary: Injecto Polymers reported a 34.5 percent increase in revenue to 193.54 crore rupees for the half year ended September 30, 2026. Profit after tax rose 95.2 percent to 10.66 crore rupees. The company noted that profits grew faster than turnover due to improved cost absorption.

stories.title: AMD Industries narrows Q2 net loss
stories.summary: AMD Industries reported a standalone net loss of 271.92 lakh rupees for Q2FY27, narrowing from a loss of 294.60 lakh rupees in the same period last year. Standalone revenue rose to 7,552.52 lakh rupees. For the first half of the fiscal year, standalone profit turned positive.

stories.title: Injecto Polymers H1 profit doubles to Rs 11 crore, revenue rises 34% to Rs 194 crore - Moneycontrol.com
AMD Industries reports Q2 revenue growth
stories.summary: AMD Industries disclosed a standalone net loss of 271.92 lakh rupees for the second quarter of fiscal year 2027. Revenue from operations reached 7,852.52 lakh rupees, up from 5,896.37 lakh rupees in the prior year. The board approved the results during a meeting on November 14.

stories.title: Enjay Converters Ltd ("Enjay") is pleased to announce the acquisition of New Method Packaging LLC ("New Method") - Stree
Stratasys terminates Machforge acquisition
stories.summary: Stratasys has cancelled its planned acquisition of Machforge Inc. and reduced its 2026 financial outlook. Despite the termination, the company reported a 4.1 percent increase in third-quarter revenue, which it attributed to strong demand from the aerospace sector.

stories.title: Professional Plastics acquires Plastic Systems
stories.summary: Professional Plastics has acquired Buffalo-based manufacturer Plastic Systems from Innovative Concepts in Entertainment. The deal expands the company's thermoforming and fabrication capabilities in Western New York. Financial terms of the acquisition were not disclosed.

stories.title: B&A Packaging India releases Q2 results
stories.summary: B&A Packaging India Limited has announced its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026. The board of directors approved the report, which details revenue, expenses and profit before tax. Segment-wise performance and asset liabilities were included in the filing.

stories.title: B&A Packaging India reports Q2 FY27 results
stories.summary: B&A Packaging India Limited announced its unaudited standalone financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. Revenue from operations reached 5,238.18 for the quarter, up from 4,193.54 during the same period last year. The board approved the statements following a limited review by statutory auditors.
